Learn the game

The court, the words and our first action, Dribble at. Three levels. Each one ends with a quiz.

Young players start at Level 1. Academy and Men do all three.

The court

Every spot and line has a name. Tap one to see it.

The rules

Six rules that make our offense work. Pick one and watch it.

Dribble at

Four out, one in. When a teammate dribbles at you, you cut back door. Step through it, then pick your number and learn your job.

The court is drawn with JavaScript. Turn it on to use the levels and the quizzes.

Words

The words we use at practice. Kids words are the Level 1 ones.

Watch it

Coaches call the first part the dribble at back cut. The handoff, roll and lift that keep it going is called 5-out continuity, or Continuous Pistols.
